SEO Specialist

Ryvo

🇮🇩 Indonesia · Jakarta

Tentang pekerjaan

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented SEO Specialist to improve website visibility, increase organic traffic, and strengthen search engine performance.

The ideal candidate understands both on-page and technical SEO , is comfortable conducting keyword and competitor research, and can turn SEO data into clear, actionable improvements. You should be able to work independently, identify opportunities proactively, and track the impact of your work.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve organic rankings and traffic

Conduct keyword research and identify new ranking opportunities

Optimize website pages, titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and content

Perform technical SEO audits and identify issues affecting website performance

Monitor indexing, crawlability, site structure, redirects, broken links, and page speed

Conduct competitor and SERP analysis

Develop content recommendations based on search intent and keyword opportunities

Work with writers, designers, and developers to implement SEO improvements

Build and improve internal linking strategies

Identify backlink and off-page SEO opportunities

Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and other SEO KPIs

Use Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and SEO tools to analyze performance

Prepare regular SEO reports and recommend next steps

Stay current with Google algorithm updates and SEO best practices

Requirements

Proven experience in SEO or a similar digital marketing role

Strong understanding of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO

Experience with keyword research and competitor analysis

Familiarity with tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms

Understanding of WordPress and website content management

Ability to identify and troubleshoot common technical SEO issues

Strong analytical and research skills

Excellent attention to detail

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Proactive approach to identifying problems and opportunities

Must be available to work 5:00 AM – 1:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday

Preferred Qualifications

Experience improving rankings and organic traffic for existing websites

Experience with local SEO

Understanding of basic HTML/CSS

Experience with WordPress and Elementor

Knowledge of backlink analysis and link-building strategies

Experience creating SEO content briefs

Familiarity with conversion optimization and website analytics

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who goes beyond simply checking keywords and rankings. The right candidate should be able to analyze a website, identify what is limiting its organic growth, prioritize improvements, and execute a clear SEO strategy.

When applying, please include examples of websites or SEO projects you have worked on and, where possible, measurable results such as improvements in rankings, organic traffic, leads, or conversions.
